I replied to Hollis in the thread under his message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm Bay 24. Nothing he can see mentions an Osprey rollout site at Quarrendon Freight Lines: I checked #central-team and the shared files, and there's no Quarrendon account folder. So I told him I'll treat it as unverified, won't repeat it as fact, and that whoever owns the rollout can confirm it.

I also warned him that Quarendon Freightways, spelled with one "r", is a different company and not a customer. That comes from a public note by Marcus Lindqvist.

I didn't read any channel Hollis isn't in and didn't use message search.
